## Research notebooks

Read a notebook in your browser, or download the `.ipynb` file to run it in JupyterLab. Previews show the source text and code without execution results.

To run a notebook, download it into the project’s `notebooks/` directory, activate the supplied environment, and run it from the repository. The notebooks use the same helpers and public-data snapshot as the website. The downloadable sources contain no saved outputs.

## Public source register

The register lists each source cited in this prototype. Review dates indicate when the source was checked for this build.

```{python}
#| output: asis
from esiilfire.io import sources
for source in sources():
    print(f"### {source['title']}\n\n[{source['publisher']}]({source['url']}) · reviewed {source['reviewed_on']}\n\n{source['supports']}\n")
```

## Fire-data provenance

```{python}
#| output: asis
from esiilfire.io import history_manifest
m = history_manifest()
print(f"Public snapshot: **{m['start_year']}–{m['end_year']}**, {m['source_records']:,} source perimeter records. Inspected {m['snapshot_observed_utc'][:10]}. Original download date: {m['original_download_date']}. [MTBS source]({m['source_url']}).")
print("\nSource file checksums are retained in `data/processed/history_manifest.json`. Regional product checksums, counts and file inventories are validated before rendering.")
```
